title: How to Trim and Compress a Video on iPhone in One Go
description: Video too long to send? Trim and compress it in one app on iPhone: cut the part you need, shrink the size, save. The fastest way to shrink a long clip.
h1: How to trim and compress a video on iPhone
card_title: Trim and compress in one go
card_summary: Cutting seconds is the cheapest size win. Trim, then compress the rest.
keywords: trim and compress video iphone, video too long to send iphone, cut video iphone smaller, shorten video to send
quick_answer: In Compress Video tap Trim Video, drag the handles to keep only the part you need, tap Save, then tap Compress. Size scales with duration, so cutting a 60-second clip to 15 seconds removes about three quarters of it before compression even starts.
intro: Photos can trim too, but the trimmed part keeps the original bitrate, so a 4K clip stays heavy. Trimming and compressing together gets you a small file in one pass.

screenshot.caption: Drag the handles, tap Save, then compress.

sections.heading: Trim in Photos vs trim in Compress Video

items.name: Open the clip
items.text: Pick the video in Compress Video.

items.name: Tap Trim Video
items.text: Drag the start and end handles; the selected length is shown above the timeline. Tap Save.

items.name: Compress
items.text: Open Compress settings, pick resolution, frame rate and audio, tap Compress.

items.name: Save
items.text: Check the new size and tap Download Compressed.

faq.question: Can I undo a trim?
faq.answer: Yes. Tap Original to go back to the untouched clip; the source video is never changed.
